tables.name: public.admin_org_overview
tables.comment: Admin view. Orgs with counts; rows only when app.is_admin = 'true'.
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW admin_org_overview AS (
 SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    status,
    is_demo,
    created_at,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM buildings b
          WHERE ((b.org_id = o.id) AND (b.archived_at IS NULL))))::integer AS building_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM units u
          WHERE ((u.org_id = o.id) AND (u.archived_at IS NULL))))::integer AS unit_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM leases l
          WHERE ((l.org_id = o.id) AND (l.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::lease_status, 'notice'::lease_status])))))::integer AS active_lease_count,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM memberships m
          WHERE ((m.org_id = o.id) AND (m.status = 'active'::membership_status))))::integer AS member_count
   FROM organizations o
  WHERE (current_setting('app.is_admin'::text, true) = 'true'::text)
)

tables.name: public.admin_health
tables.comment: Admin view. Job runs, failed outbox, flagged/stuck intents; admin context only.
tables.def:
CREATE VIEW admin_health AS (
 SELECT kind,
    id,
    org_id,
    name,
    status,
    attempts,
    at,
    finished_at
   FROM ( SELECT 'job_run'::text AS kind,
            j.id,
            NULL::uuid AS org_id,
            j.job AS name,
            (j.status)::text AS status,
            NULL::integer AS attempts,
            j.started_at AS at,
            j.finished_at
           FROM job_runs j
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'outbox_failed'::text,
            x.id,
            x.org_id,
            x.type,
            (x.status)::text AS status,
            x.attempts,
            x.updated_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone
           FROM outbox x
          WHERE (x.status = 'failed'::outbox_status)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'intent_flagged'::text,
            p.id,
            p.org_id,
            'payment_intent'::text,
            (p.status)::text AS status,
            NULL::integer,
            p.updated_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone
           FROM payment_intents p
          WHERE (p.status = 'flagged'::payment_intent_status)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'intent_stuck'::text,
            p.id,
            p.org_id,
            'payment_intent'::text,
            (p.status)::text AS status,
            NULL::integer,
            p.created_at,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone
           FROM payment_intents p
          WHERE ((p.status = 'initiated'::payment_intent_status) AND (p.created_at < (now() - '00:30:00'::interval)))) h
  WHERE (current_setting('app.is_admin'::text, true) = 'true'::text)
)
